I’m working on making sure to mention the main heading as Playfair Display and the subtitle as Roboto. I'll need to scope them to BlogHeader while ensuring that tests build and TypeScript compilation (tsc) are all in place. The user's changes will remain untouched, so I have to keep that in mind while finalizing everything. I want to ensure it’s all properly set up and looks great!

shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md; printf '\\n--- BlogHeader ---\\n'; cat app/BlogHeader.tsx; printf '\\n--- Layout / Styles / Package ---\\n'; cat app/layout.tsx; rg --files app; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- Local font docs ---\\n'; rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg '(font|fonts)' | head -60; printf '\\n--- Status ---\\n'; git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/13-fonts.md; printf '\\n--- API font guide excerpts ---\\n'; rg -n 'Playfair|Roboto|next/font/google|className|variable|subsets|weight|style=' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/font.md | head -95; printf '\\n--- page ---\\n'; cat app/page.tsx; printf '\\n--- nested instructions ---\\n'; rg --files app -g 'AGENTS.md'"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n '"'^export declare const (Playfair_Display|Roboto):|''^export const (Playfair_Display|Roboto)'"\\b|Playfair_Display:|Roboto:' node_modules/next/dist/compiled/@next/font/dist/google/index.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/compiled/@next/font/dist/google/index.js node_modules/next/dist/compiled/@next/font/dist/google/font-data.json node_modules/next/dist/compiled/@next/font/dist/google/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -25; sed -n '110,155p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/13-fonts.md; sed -n '455,495p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/font.md"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH' *** Begin Patch *** Update File: app/BlogHeader.tsx @@ +import { Playfair_Display, Roboto } from 'next/font/google' + +const playfairDisplay = Playfair_Display({ subsets: ['latin'] }) +const roboto = Roboto({ subsets: ['latin'], weight: '400' }) + export default function BlogHeader() { return (
-

My Personal Blog

-

Thoughts, ideas, and musings

+

My Personal Blog

+

Thoughts, ideas, and musings

) } *** End Patch PATCH npx tsc --noEmit && git diff --check && git diff -- app/BlogHeader.tsx"
/bin/bash -c 'find .next -depth -delete && unlink next-env.d.ts && unlink tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- tsconfig.json'
